grains.RAW.EXPORTERS: one row per exporter (city and product line)
grains.RAW.EXPORTER_DAILY: one row per exporter per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.COMPLIANCE_DOCUMENTS: one row per exporter (export document snapshot)
grains.CURATED.ISSUE_SUMMARY: one row per shipment issue type

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day all-exporter shipment-issue FORECAST; document discrepancy rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ISSUE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic shipment-issue handling SOPs (one per product line and issue type with a rejection)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.FOOD_EXPORT_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.FOOD_EXPORT_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, exporter, issue-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (exporters, daily shipment issues, rejected shipments by exporter, shipment-rejection risk, shipment events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_SHIPMENTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_SHIPMENT_ALERT logs new ISSUE events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.reject_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(rejected shipment for the exporter in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
